import glob
api = '''def parse_row(text, *, strict=False):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    if strict and len(fields) < 3:
        raise ValueError("expected at least 3 comma-separated fields, got %d" % len(fields))
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "amount": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}
'''
changes = {'billing/api.py': api}
for f in glob.glob('billing/*.py'):
    if f.endswith('api.py') or f.endswith('__init__.py'):
        continue
    src = open(f).read()
    new = src.replace('from .api import parse\n', 'from .api import parse_row\n').replace('row = parse(text)', 'row = parse_row(text)')
    assert 'parse(' not in new.replace('parse_row(', ''), f
    changes[f] = new
commit(changes)
print(open('billing/api.py').read())
print(open('billing/alpha.py').read())

def parse_row(text, *, strict=False):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    if strict and len(fields) < 3:
        raise ValueError("expected at least 3 comma-separated fields, got %d" % len(fields))
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "amount": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}
